email_body:
Just to follow-up on our discussion yesterday regarding the accounting treatment assuming that USTeleNet owns the switch and that we purchase the switch and lease it back to them under a "capital" lease, the following would occur:  The asset would stay on their books (however it would be "marked-up" to FMV as evidenced by the purchase price) They would defer the gain, if any, over the asset's life.
They would record a payable on their balance sheet and recognize interest expense in their P&L as payments are made We would record the payment of cash to them and book a receivable and deferred interest income (to be recognized over the lease term)  Essentially we are lending them money equal to the FMV of their asset and receiving interest payments in return (i.e.

The Grid South order will also include language requiring an independent board.
After the independent board is established, it should choose an operator of the RTO.

STRAWBERRIES ROMANOFF    1 1/2 pounds firm ripe strawberries, washed, dried, stemmed & quartered lengthwise (reserve 6 berries with stems for garnish)  1/4 cup Grand Marnier (can use Triple Sec or Cointreau)  1/4 cup sugar  Chantilly Romanoff 3 tbs chopped pistachio nuts (garnish)   Combine berries and liqueur in large bowl and sprinkle with sugar.

Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 4 hours, spooning syrup over berries once or twice.
One hour before serving, divide berries and syrup among 6 sherbert or balloon wine glasses.
Refrigerate.
Just before serving, spoon Chantilly Romanoff over berries and garnish with reserved strawberries.
Sprinkle each serving with pistachio nuts.
CHANTILLY ROMANOFF  1 cup heavy whipping cream, well chilled  2 tbs Grand Marnier  1/2 tsp vanilla  1/2 cup sour cream, chilled   Beat cream in large mixing bowl until slightly thickened.
Add liqueur and vanilla and continue beating until soft peaks form.
Fold in sour cream, then beat until mixture is thick and holds its shape.
Refrigerate until ready to use.
